AD_MODULE.NAME: Etendo Modern Skin Shell
AD_MODULE.DESCRIPTION: Visual shell for the Etendo 3.0 UI: theme runtime and tokens, navigation, top bar, toolbar, forms, grids and the login page
AD_MODULE.HELP: Restyles the Etendo 3.0 user interface and the login page without editing core. The palette, typography and density come from the ETSKIN_Theme preference and the navigation from ETSKIN_Navigation, so a single compiled stylesheet serves every client; setting ETSKIN_Enabled to N falls back to the stock look. Application screens are not part of this module.
